questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like tractors, road maintenance vehicles, and carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Proceed at a consistent speed while looking and listening for approaching trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for any trains, and be prepared to stop if any trains are nearby.
questions.explanation: At this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains and be ready to stop. Never try to outdrive a train.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they must follow the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped yellow signs mark a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warning signs. This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for pedestrians and let them cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warning signs. This sign warns of a fork in the road ahead. You must go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warning signs. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and control your speed to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warning signs. They alert you to upcoming conditions. Speed advisory plaques show the recommended speed for the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left only on a green arrow.
May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Must wait for the solid green light before you turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. After yielding, you may follow the remaining directions on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road, entrance, or exit. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around and do not proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road ahead ends at an intersection. Slow down and prepare to yield or stop before turning right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a winding road ahead. Reduce your speed and adjust your driving appropriately.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for vehicles on the other road to pass before you proceed. You do not need to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but always slow down and enter with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low clearance ahead. It shows the distance from the road surface to the bottom of a bridge or overpass. In this example, the clearance is 12 feet, 6 inches.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A left arm straight out means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a side road intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead, usually posted several hundred feet before the tracks. Drivers should slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming up. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Stop if needed before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers, such as rest areas, food, gas, or hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot reverse direction at this location.
